name: Northguard
title: The Crown's Pass Post
examine: Weld colors, drilled straight, and young enough to think the quiet is normal. The captain is working on that.
lines: The gate opens at dawn and bars at the beacon. Those are the only two rules you need.
Two days to Hartfell if you stay on the road. Longer if you do not, and then forever.
The tower watches the water. We watch the road. Everybody watches us. It works.
